decisions.reason: Identifies dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as the koffi.node owner; loaded image stays mapped until process exit, so npm's copyfile hits EBUSY.
Refresh/close only reloads the browser client and never stops the host; ordered procedure given: fully stop and verify dsh processes, pinned install from external terminal, restart and verify.
Bare name follows latest=0.1.1-rc.2 (alpha tag holds 0.1.2-alpha.5); npm does not preserve or advance the installed alpha.4, so the README command silently downgrades.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 together with the TUI plugin after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints alpha.5, then restarts dsh web.
Tells authors to pin exact versions in every install command that includes dsh, never publish bare names, and states the supported corridor so latest never silently overrides a prerelease.
